targets.title: Environmental enrichment as an effective treatment for autism: a randomized controlled trial
targets.evidence_quote: In the present study, we sought to replicate the objectively assessed improvement in cognitive abilities that we had previously found following sensorimotor enrichment, using the Leiter International Performance Scale – Revised (Leiter-R).
targets.outcome_quote: This randomized controlled trial has replicated the findings that sensorimotor enrichment can improve outcomes in children with autism. We again found that the gains in cognitive performance of enriched children with autism significantly exceeded that of controls ( Woo & Leon, 2013 ).
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall replication verdict confirms improved outcomes; the cognitive comparison confirms the specified target. The null expressive-language difference agrees with the earlier null finding. Other cited trials contextualize the findings but are not independently re-tested targets.
